include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# timeout.exe is all Rust (timeout-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/timeout-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# timeout.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/timeout-rust/src/timeout/timeout.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(timeout_res OBJECT timeout.rc)
target_compile_definitions(timeout_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(timeout_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(TIMEOUT_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils_rust.a)
add_cargo_module(timeout timeout-cargo timeout.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE timeout-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS timeout_res ${TIMEOUT_REUSED})
